title: The Gentle Shadow
hook: A vampire’s worst mistake is a girl who refuses to become cruel.
description: Rowan should have died in 1527. Instead, she survives a vampire’s bite and remains stubbornly herself. Five hundred years later, she is back in high school, making impossible scarves, looking after a werewolf, and building a found family the old bloodlines cannot tolerate.

title: The Weight of Memory
hook: Viktor has a soul again. Being a monster was simpler.
description: Memory and grief have returned to Viktor, along with a form of strength he cannot explain. A researcher wants to understand his transformation, and the people he cares about become part of her investigation. Rowan brings soup and scarves. Viktor must learn what to do with a life that finally matters to him.

title: Fall from Space
hook: An orbital childhood. A damaged Earth. A system that can make ideas live.
description: Sent down to Earth with an AI named Egg and a biological design system, Grayson must build the basics of survival before he can repair an ecosystem. Every living solution creates consequences, dependencies, and questions that a simulation cannot answer for him.
note: This is the published edition. The series and its earlier wiki continuity are being revised.

title: The Thousandfold Gate
hook: A second chance at twenty-five, paid for one crystal at a time.
description: A worn-out dock foreman limps into Dungeon City with a bad knee and an empty ledger. The Dungeon makes him twenty-five again, then hands him the bill. In a world where every power charges rent, each tier of power is ten times the last, and climbing one costs a thousand crystals of the tier below, Terry has to build a new life one red crystal at a time.
note: Book One of a new series from MES Publishing. Coming to Amazon.
